description: This is a localization (i18n) source file providing Czech translations for a chat application, including UI labels, prompts, and functions for dynamic content.

methods.name: ChatItemCount
methods.description: Returns a string with the count of chat messages in Czech.

methods.name: SubTitle
methods.description: Returns a Czech string indicating the number of messages with ChatGPT.

methods.name: Actions
methods.description: Provides labels for chat actions such as navigating, exporting, copying, stopping, retrying, deleting.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Generates placeholder hints for chat input based on the submit key.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Displays the current version of the app in Czech.

methods.name: IsLatest
methods.description: Indicates if the current version is the latest.

methods.name: CheckUpdate
methods.description: Text for button to check for updates.

methods.name: FoundUpdate
methods.description: Displays message when a new app version is found.

methods.name: SendKey
methods.description: Label for the send key setting.

methods.name: TightBorder
methods.description: Label for toggle for tight borders.

methods.name: Title
methods.description: Various titles in settings and UI.

methods.name: SubTitle
methods.description: Various subtitles in settings and UI.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Label for name fields, e.g., language, avatar.

methods.name: InjectSystemPrompts
methods.description: Toggle label for injecting system prompts.

methods.name: HistoryCount
methods.description: Label and subtitle for history count setting.

methods.name: CompressThreshold
methods.description: Title and subtitle for compression threshold setting.

methods.name: MaxTokens
methods.description: Label for maximum token count setting.

methods.name: Prompt
methods.description: Prompt-related functions for summarization and topic generation.

methods.name: NewChat
methods.description: Labels and prompts for starting new chats.
